description.text: Cybersecurity is indispensable to our digital way of life, with millions of cyberattacks resulting in trillions of dollars in damages. We are in the midst of a generational shift in cybersecurity, ushered in by the ongoing digital transformation of the enterprise and the rise of AI. Attacks can inflict damages that span operational disruption, leadership change, loss of customer trust, and intellectual property theft, among others. The persistence and speed of cyberattacks clearly shows that there is a long way to go from here. Enterprises must deploy solutions that enable them to stay one step ahead of attackers and address intrusion attempts in real-time at machine speed—empowering human operators with the speed, scale, visibility, and precision of technology. We envisioned a revolutionary data and AI paradigm where technology alone could autonomously prevent, detect, and respond to cyberattacks. It is time to fight machine with machine. We pioneered the world’s first purpose-built AI-powered cybersecurity platform for autonomous defense. Our autonomous cybersecurity solutions are intelligent and data-driven systems that learn and evolve on their own—working to make the world more secure. By leveraging AI and our fully unified security data lake for analytics, our Singularity Platform instantly defends against cyberattacks—performing at a faster speed, greater scale, and higher accuracy than otherwise possible from any single human or even a crowd.

about.description_short: SentinelOne (NYSE: S) is the leader in AI security, setting the standard for using AI and automation to give defenders a decisive operating advantage. Built for those who secure our world, its platform delivers unified coverage across endpoints, identity, cloud, and AI. Powered by Autonomous Security Intelligence, SentinelOne stops attacks at machine speed, reducing risk and delivering clarity and control to stay one step ahead. Headquartered in Mountain View, California, with teams worldwide, SentinelOne protects nearly one-fifth of the Fortune 500 and hundreds of Global 2000 enterprises. From Main Street to Wall Street, the world's most critical organizations trust SentinelOne with their security.

analysis_md:
# S — SentinelOne, Inc.
Pass-1 run, 2026-10-20 (engine release 5.5.0). All figures below are copied from key_numbers.md, dcf_numbers.json, ttm.json, financials_history.csv or fundamentals.json — none are recomputed.

## What it is
AI-native cybersecurity platform (Singularity): endpoint protection as the core, expanding into cloud security, identity, and data/SIEM (Purple AI), sold by subscription. Fiscal years end January 31 — "FY2026" is the year ended 2026-01-31. Revenue was $1,001,278,000 in FY2026 (+21.9% YoY), and at Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended 2026-07-31) ARR was $1.218B, +22% YoY, with FY2027 revenue guidance raised to $1.202B–$1.207B (company Q2 FY2027 release, via search).

## Owner's earnings
**FY2026 (10-K via EDGAR, from financials_history.csv):** operating cash flow $76,616,000; capex $918,000 (rollup: PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment $713,000 + PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets $205,000 — key_numbers.md capex basis FY2026); SBC $297,587,000 (always a real cost).
- **Conservative owner's earnings FY2026: $-221,889,000 = $-0.67/share** (key_numbers.md: latest FY OE/share $-0.67; latest FY OE total $-221.9M).
- Maintenance version FY2026 (NI + D&A − min(capex, D&A) − ΔNWC, financials_history.csv oe_maintenance): $-251,728,000 — also negative; the two definitions agree here because capex is trivially small and SBC dominates both.
- OE positive in **0 of the last 5 fiscal years** (key_numbers.md). Per-share OE ran $-1.31 (FY2023), $-0.98 (FY2024), $-0.75 (FY2025), $-0.67 (FY2026) — improving each year, but still negative in every year on record, because SBC has grown in dollars every year ($164,466,000 FY2023 → $216,870,000 FY2024 → $267,531,000 FY2025 → $297,587,000 FY2026) faster than operating cash flow.
- Balance sheet (10-K balance sheet at 2026-01-31, via the Q4 FY2026 release): **no borrowings** — total liabilities of $1,000,957,000 are accounts payable and accruals, deferred revenue ($549,790,000 current + $83,277,000 non-current) and other liabilities of $161,325,000, against cash of $169,627,000, short-term investments of $459,041,000 and long-term investments of $140,898,000; stockholders' equity $1,437,145,000. The engine's net debt is blank (DEBT_TAGS_BLANK, below) — the filing's answer is that there is no debt to tag. Subsequent event from research, after the FY2026 balance-sheet date: in October 2026 the company announced a $1.25B convertible notes offering, so "debt-free" is a FY2026-end statement, not a current one.

**Base used = the engine's normalized base, median of the last 3 FY OE/share: $-0.75/share** (key_numbers.md; base_source: median_of_last_3_fy_oe_per_share). No TTM pin was used, because the TTM figure is worse, not better (below) — there is no base choice on which this company has positive owner's earnings.

**TTM check (ttm.py through Q2 FY2027, legs quoted from ttm.json):**
- OCF: FY $76,616,000 − prior YTD $51,231,000 + current YTD $31,948,000 = **TTM $57,333,000**
- Capex: FY $918,000 − prior YTD $510,000 + current YTD $606,000 = **TTM $1,014,000**
- SBC: FY $297,587,000 − prior YTD $142,539,000 + current YTD $167,003,000 = **TTM $322,051,000**
- Shares (current-YTD weighted diluted): **339,301,479**
- **TTM OE/share $-0.78** (ttm.json) — SBC is still growing faster than OCF in the current year (H1 FY2027 SBC $167,003,000 included $92,114,000 in Q2 alone, ~32% of that quarter's revenue), so the trailing picture deteriorates rather than rescues the FY base.

## Moat: 4/10 — weak-to-narrow
Justification: a recognised AI-native endpoint leader with platform breadth expanding into cloud, identity and SIEM (Purple AI; Observo acquisition), ~74% gross margin and ARR of $1.218B growing 22% — but ROIC (fundamentals.json roic_proxy) was negative in each of FY2023–FY2026 (−20.9%, −22.4%, −17.5%, −20.0%; early-year values in the series are artefacts of a negative equity base around the IPO and are not quoted), GAAP operating losses in every year on record, and SBC of 29.7% of FY2026 revenue keeps owner's earnings negative despite positive operating cash flow. Gross margin has also slipped at the margin: 74.3% (FY2025) → 74.1% (FY2026) → 72% in Q2 FY2027 vs 75% a year earlier (Q2 FY2027 release coverage).
- FOR: AI-native Singularity platform, a recognised endpoint-protection leader, expanding into cloud, identity, data/SIEM (Purple AI; Observo acquisition closed in the FY2026 window, goodwill $629,636,000 → $912,671,000); software economics at the gross line — gross margin 74.1% in FY2026, ARR $1.218B at Q2 FY2027, +22% YoY; land-and-expand evidence — customers with ≥$100,000 ARR grew 13% to 1,715 at Q2 FY2027, FY2027 revenue guidance raised to $1.202B–$1.207B; debt-free balance sheet at FY2026 end (above).
- AGAINST: no returns evidence — ROIC proxy negative every year FY2023–FY2026 and GAAP operating losses every year, gross margin slipping; SBC is the model's real cost — $297,587,000 in FY2026 and $322,051,000 TTM, growing in dollars every year, diluted shares +5.9%/yr; scale disadvantage vs CrowdStrike (larger, cash-generative) and bundling pressure from Microsoft Defender, with endpoint share re-won each platform cycle; growth decelerating (+32.2% FY2025, +21.9% FY2026, ~+20% guided FY2027) while SBC dollars still rise — operating leverage so far is non-GAAP only (Q2 FY2027 non-GAAP operating margin 10% vs GAAP −31%).
- A 4 gives CAP = 7.2 years (key_numbers.md): growth would hold 2 years, then converge to the 2.5% terminal rate over 7.2 years — moot while the base is negative.

## My thoughts / method range / hurdle price
- The method range here is one-sided: median FY base $-0.75/share, latest FY $-0.67/share, TTM $-0.78/share — every defensible base is negative, so the verdict does not depend on base choice, growth starts or scenario weights. Tier F is robust in a way a marginal F would not be.
- What the $22.19 price (market cap $7.324B, key_numbers.md) is actually buying is a plausible path: revenue growth ~20%+ with a 74% gross margin, non-GAAP operating margin reaching 10% in Q2 FY2027, and SBC/revenue falling ~2–5 points a year. If SBC merely held flat in dollars while revenue compounded at ~20%, owner's earnings would turn positive within a couple of years. The filings through Q2 FY2027 do not yet show that: SBC dollars rose again in H1 FY2027 ($167,003,000 vs $142,539,000 a year earlier) and Q2 GAAP operating margin was −31%. An owner's-earnings screen cannot underwrite the inflection before it prints — and the new $1.25B convertible issue adds a future dilution/interest leg the FY2026 balance sheet did not have.
- Hurdle-clearing price: **none is computable** — IV@15% is null on a negative base (score.json). There is no price at which a negative owner's-earnings stream clears a 15% hurdle inside this model; the name must first print positive conservative OE, which on the current SBC trajectory means SBC dollars flattening, not just shrinking as a percentage of revenue.

## Final verdict
- **Final tier: F** (tier_by_numbers F, no tier_override; F sub-type sbc_exceeds_cash)
- Confidence: **low** (high that historical and TTM owner's earnings are negative — that is filing arithmetic; low on how fast SBC flattens in dollars, which is what any future re-score turns on)
